blogs.title: How Vaccines Train Your Immune System Effectively
blogs.title_hi: टीका आपकी इम्यून सिस्टम को कैसे प्रशिक्षित करता है?
blogs.content:
Vaccines play a crucial role in public health by training the immune system to recognize and combat pathogens. By introducing a harmless component of a virus or bacteria, vaccines stimulate the body's immune response without causing the disease. This process allows the immune system to prepare itself for future encounters with the actual pathogen.

Understanding how vaccines work helps demystify their importance. They not only protect individuals but also contribute to herd immunity, which is vital for safeguarding those who cannot be vaccinated. Let’s explore how vaccines effectively train the immune system.
